content: Guitar Player, D'Addario Lesson Room, and Premier Guitar converge on a segmented routine: ~10min warmup (chromatic/scale runs, alternate picking or hammer-on/pull-off patterns), ~10min technique (scales/arpeggios/chords in isolation), ~10min scales, ~20min repertoire/songs, ~10min reading; always start at a slow, clean tempo and increase gradually rather than starting at speed.
